; unremarkable - local LLM presets from Quick Settings.
; Requires: qt-resource-rebuilder, qt-command-executor.

SLOT unremarkableButton
    INSERT {
        QuickSettingsToggle {
            id: unremarkableButton
            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/notebook_sparkles"
            enabled: true
            selected: false

            property string outText: ""
            property string runStatus: "idle"
            property var meta: null

            CommandExecutor { id: unremarkableRunner }

            // xovi sets QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_READ, so the panel can poll the
            // state files ask.sh streams into.
            property string preset: ""

            function stripQuotes(text) {
                var marks = String.fromCharCode(34, 39, 8220, 8221, 8216, 8217);
                while (text.length > 0 && marks.indexOf(text.charAt(0)) >= 0) {
                    text = text.substring(1);
                }
                while (text.length > 0
                       && marks.indexOf(text.charAt(text.length - 1)) >= 0) {
                    text = text.substring(0, text.length - 1);
                }
                return text.trim();
            }

            function wordCount(text) {
                if (!text) return 0;
                var parts = text.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).join(" ").split(" ");
                var total = 0;
                for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
                    if (parts[i].length > 0) total++;
                }
                return total;
            }

            function firstStanza(raw) {
                if (!raw) return "";
                var text = raw;
                var split = text.indexOf(String.fromCharCode(10, 10));
                if (split >= 0) text = text.substring(0, split);
                text = stripQuotes(text.trim());
                var lines = text.split(String.fromCharCode(10));
                if (lines.length > 10) lines = lines.slice(0, 10);
                return lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
            }

            function readFile(path, cb) {
                var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
                    if (xhr.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) cb(xhr.responseText);
                };
                xhr.open("GET", "file://" + path);
                xhr.send();
            }

            function poll() {
                readFile("/home/root/unremarkable/state/out.txt",
                         function(t) { unremarkableButton.outText = t; });
                readFile("/home/root/unremarkable/state/status",
                         function(s) {
                             unremarkableButton.runStatus = s;
                             if (s === "done") pollTimer.stop();
                         });
                readFile("/home/root/unremarkable/state/meta.json",
                         function(m) {
                             try { unremarkableButton.meta = JSON.parse(m); }
                             catch (e) { unremarkableButton.meta = null; }
                         });
            }

            // Window.window is null here and the toggle itself is only 96x96, so
            // walk up to the scene root and centre the panel against that.
            function topLevelItem() {
                var node = unremarkableButton;
                while (node.parent) { node = node.parent; }
                return node;
            }

            function ask(name) {
                console.log("[unremarkable] ask " + name);
                unremarkableButton.preset = name;
                var preset = name;
                outText = "";
                runStatus = "running";
                unremarkableRunner.executeCommand("/bin/sh",
                    ["-c", "/home/root/unremarkable/ask.sh " + preset
                           + " 80 >/dev/null 2>&1 &"]);
                pollTimer.start();
            }

            Timer {
                id: pollTimer
                interval: 2000
                repeat: true
                onTriggered: unremarkableButton.poll()
            }

            onClicked: {
                selected = true;
                var root = topLevelItem();
                console.log("[unremarkable] root " + root.width + "x" + root.height);
                unremarkablePanel.parent = root;
                unremarkableButton.poll();
                unremarkablePanel.open();
            }

            Popup {
                id: unremarkablePanel
                modal: true
                focus: true
                width: 1000
                height: 1180
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                padding: 0
                closePolicy: Popup.CloseOnEscape | Popup.CloseOnPressOutside

                background: Rectangle {
                    color: "#ffffff"
                    border.color: "#000000"
                    border.width: 3
                }

                onOpened: console.log("[unremarkable] opened in " + parent.width
                                      + "x" + parent.height)

                contentItem: Item {
                    Column {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        anchors.margins: 64
                        spacing: 0

                        Text {
                            text: "Unremarkable"
                            font.family: "EB Garamond"
                            font.pixelSize: 52
                            color: "#000000"
                        }
                        Text {
                            text: unremarkableButton.runStatus === "running"
                                  ? "Generating a " + unremarkableButton.preset
                                    + "\u2026"
                                  : "a small language model, thinking on this tablet"
                            font.family: "EB Garamond"
                            font.italic: true
                            font.pixelSize: 28
                            color: "#000000"
                            topPadding: 6
                        }

                        Item { width: 1; height: 26 }
                        Rectangle { width: 872; height: 2; color: "#000000" }
                        Item { width: 1; height: 40 }

                        Grid {
                            columns: 2
                            spacing: 20
                            Repeater {
                                model: [["poem", "Poem"], ["journal", "Journal"],
                                        ["story", "Story"], ["idea", "Idea"]]
                                Rectangle {
                                    width: 426; height: 96
                                    color: "#ffffff"
                                    border.color: "#000000"
                                    border.width: 2
                                    Text {
                                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                                        text: modelData[1]
                                        font.family: "EB Garamond"
                                        font.pixelSize: 36
                                        color: "#000000"
                                    }
                                    MouseArea {
                                        anchors.fill: parent
                                        onClicked: unremarkableButton.ask(modelData[0])
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Item { width: 1; height: 44 }

                        Text {
                            width: 872
                            text: unremarkableButton.outText === ""
                                  ? "\u00b7 \u00b7 \u00b7"
                                  : unremarkableButton.firstStanza(
                                        unremarkableButton.outText)
                            font.family: "EB Garamond"
                            font.pixelSize: 40
                            color: "#000000"
                            lineHeight: 1.4
                            lineHeightMode: Text.ProportionalHeight
                            wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                            maximumLineCount: 9
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                        }
                    }

                    Column {
                        anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                        anchors.left: parent.left
                        anchors.right: parent.right
                        anchors.margins: 64
                        spacing: 18

                        Rectangle { width: 872; height: 1; color: "#000000" }
                        Text {
                            text: "SmolLM2-135M-Instruct \u00b7 135M params \u00b7 fp32 \u00b7 "
                                  + "49152 vocab"
                            font.family: "Noto Sans Mono"
                            font.pixelSize: 19
                            color: "#000000"
                        }
                        Text {
                            text: unremarkableButton.meta
                                  ? "ttft " + (unremarkableButton.meta.ttft_ms / 1000).toFixed(1)
                                    + "s \u00b7 " + unremarkableButton.meta.decode_tok_s.toFixed(2)
                                    + " tok/s \u00b7 " + unremarkableButton.meta.generated_tokens
                                    + "/" + unremarkableButton.meta.context + " tok \u00b7 "
                                    + Math.round(unremarkableButton.meta.peak_rss_mib) + " MiB"
                                  : unremarkableButton.runStatus === "running"
                                    ? "generating \u00b7 " + unremarkableButton.wordCount(
                                        unremarkableButton.outText) + " words"
                                    : "idle \u00b7 513 MiB weights + 22 MiB kv cache"
                            font.family: "Noto Sans Mono"
                            font.pixelSize: 19
                            color: "#000000"
                        }
                    }
                }

                onClosed: {
                    pollTimer.stop();
                    unremarkableButton.selected = false;
                }
            }
        }
    }
END SLOT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/settings/qml/quicksettings/ToggleGrid.qml
    IMPORT QtQuick.Window 2.0
    IMPORT QtQuick.Controls 2.0
    IMPORT xofm.libs.settings 1.0
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
    TRAVERSE ?#root
        LOCATE AFTER Repeater
        INSERT SLOT unremarkableButton
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/settings/qml/quicksettings/ToggleColumn.qml
    IMPORT QtQuick.Window 2.0
    IMPORT QtQuick.Controls 2.0
    IMPORT xofm.libs.settings 1.0
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
    TRAVERSE ?#root
        LOCATE AFTER Repeater
        INSERT SLOT unremarkableButton
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
